skills.description: Use when authoring or reviewing n8n workflows in a project: Python or JavaScript Code nodes, portable workflow JSON (fragments or full export), normalized concise code with dense per-line Chinese comments, and disk output under a function-named workflow folder (project root or user path) containing per-node .py/.js/.json files, hierarchy prefixes like 1 / 1.1 / 1.2, plus 节点关系与分支说明.md documenting upstream/downstream, each branch as one paragraph, and every threshold/numeric literal spelled out. Use when generating BOTH executable code AND matching workflow JSON together; for sub-workflows, idempotency, error handling, credentials hygiene, and merging fragments into full exports. Use when the user asks for workflow backup reverse-engineering and has supplied both the JSON backup path and the output directory (if either is missing, remind the user and wait; do not run until both are given), and wants a single Markdown where each execution branch is one detailed Chinese paragraph (no in-body lists) narrating step-by-step logic plus optimization suggestions, a code/ folder of extracted Code-node sources, and a parallel code_optimized/ folder with behavior-equivalent deduplicated code plus detailed sectioned Chinese comments.
skills.description_zh: 面向 n8n 工作流：日常编写 Python/JavaScript Code 节点与工作流 JSON（双轨交付、逐行中文注释、可选落盘到功能文件夹并生成节点关系说明）；备份反推需在提供备份 JSON 路径与输出目录后，生成分支说明 Markdown、code/ 与 code_optimized/。
skills.name: n8n工作流编码助手
